npm <command>

Usage:
npm install        Install project dependencies
npm install <foo>  Add a project dependency
npm test           Execute project tests
npm run <foo>      Execute a named script
npm <command> -h   Display command help
npm -l            Display usage for commands

All commands:
    install, run-script, test, publish, config, help

Configuration can also be supplied as: npm <command> --key=value
